very_with_primes_outside_the_41: Found in the parts read: the chart's VERY box lists very big, very small, very good, very bad and 'I want it very much (=very)'; the LITTLE~FEW box has 'very little, very few'; GW2014 pp.34-35 'very small', 'very few things', 'very bad things'; GW2014 pp.174-176 'something very good'; GW2014 p.136 'Does it hurt very much?'; LFH22 pp.11 and 13 'something very bad'.
more_with_primes_outside_the_41: Found in the parts read: the chart's MORE~ANYMORE box has 'someone wants more' and 'not living anymore'; the MUCH~MANY box has 'much more, many more'.
